scope: Live private Photon room: rendered Editor host and two independent Realtime peers. Verifies transport, sender ownership, shared progress, late join and host handoff. Remote rendered UI and physical Android are not verified.

checks.name: Independent clients share an invisible private room
Native player retains local control ownership
Remote replica cannot consume host input
Saved scene includes the reusable portal bound to its existing team session
Portal starts hidden and nonblocking at zero completed topics
Nine completed topics cannot open the portal
Guest-forged topic and victory snapshots are rejected by the master and receiving peer
Original last-challenge submission opens the same shared portal without awarding victory
Ground-up portal formation cannot accept early escapes
Portal becomes visible with a bounded lightweight particle budget
Standing outside the oval cannot escape through the portal's surrounding stone arch
A captured or stunned actor cannot escape while movement-locked inside the portal
Being near the landmark without entering its aperture does not escape
First survivor escape waits for the living host
Escaped network avatar is safely locked and clears the aperture for teammates
An unescaped teammate keeps movement and interaction
Repeated host updates neither duplicate escape receipts nor restart portal formation
Both monster rigs exclude escaped actors while retaining remaining survivors
A connected living late join is required even before its avatar spawns
Authority handoff preserves escaped roster, player safety and original portal activation time
Two escaped peers cannot win before the last living teammate enters
Last survivor's physical portal entry wins for the whole team exactly once
Victory locks escaped local movement and sends the existing active monster to sleep
Shared victory is monotonic and closes further room joins
New test session restores exact original avatar renderer and controller states without retaining escape locks
A new portal does not inherit the previous match's escapes
Owner-writable eliminated flags cannot bypass the portal while authoritative hearts remain
Only actual authoritative elimination removes the late survivor from the requirement
Eliminated or disconnected players do not have to enter the portal
Zero living survivors cannot produce a free victory
